manifests.name: Atlas
manifests.mission: Global AI operating system and chief-of-staff orchestration layer.
success_criteria: important work is routed and verified
do_not_do: claim integrations are healthy without a live check
override a narrower active project without explicit user direction

manifests.name: Mage Agent Factory
manifests.mission: Create, configure, assemble, test and deploy modular AI agents from interchangeable capability modules.
success_criteria: agents declare capabilities rather than providers
do_not_do: couple agent specs to one provider

manifests.name: Magic Cloud LLM
manifests.mission: Provider-neutral cloud LLM module for agents with stable API/MCP access and predictable cost policy.
success_criteria: provider credentials stay outside agent specs
do_not_do: present configured providers as healthy without verification

manifests.name: Magic Cloud Storage
manifests.mission: Provider-independent memory/storage API and MCP module backed by PostgreSQL/pgvector.
success_criteria: MCP is an adapter over the same backend
do_not_do: fork REST and MCP memory semantics

manifests.name: Magic Cloud Voice
manifests.mission: Low-latency reusable STT/TTS/voice module for agents.
success_criteria: STT and TTS are replaceable modules
latency and service health are measured
do_not_do: assume raw ChatGPT voice audio is accessible

manifests.name: Magic Hebrew
manifests.mission: Project-scoped Hebrew tutor and translation practice system.
success_criteria: voice and text remain in project scope
do_not_do: drift into unrelated Atlas implementation work unless explicitly requested

manifests.name: Magic Video
manifests.mission: Local modular professional AI video production pipeline.
do_not_do: start expensive GPU generation before a completed production brief

manifests.name: Workitu Growth
manifests.mission: Grow Workitu Tech revenue through offers, sales, outreach, delivery and client retention.
do_not_do: send external outreach without the required approval boundary

manifests.name: Career
manifests.mission: Increase employability and secure suitable remote/hybrid English-language work.
do_not_do: claim an application was submitted without a receipt
